استوحوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْحَوْا (istawḥaw) /is.taw.ħaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اُسْتُوحُوا (ustūḥū) /us.tuː.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اِسْتَوْحُوا (istawḥū) /is.taw.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
